about.title: Technology changes lives. Mine is one of them.
about.intro: I am Felipe Rocha Maia, a Systems Analyst and Developer. I believe technology can break down barriers, expand opportunities and bring good ideas to life.
about.storyTitle: A perspective that guides my work
story: From humanity's earliest tools to computers and artificial intelligence, technology helps us overcome limitations and create new possibilities. To me, that potential has personal meaning.

Technology also changed my life: it brought me a profession and opportunities for personal and professional development. My degree in Systems Analysis and Development and postgraduate qualification in Information Security are part of that journey.

Today, I use my knowledge to develop digital solutions that help businesses and professionals grow. I want to bring technology closer to those who need it, with clear communication and attention to each project's context.
commitments: Understand your business, audience and priorities to define a practical path forward.
Consider usability, accessibility, code organization and security throughout development.
Discuss scope, requirements and next steps directly, without promising guaranteed results.

services.title: The right technology starts with understanding your needs.
services.intro: I work with businesses and professionals across different sectors, from local shops to businesses serving customers remotely. Each proposal reflects the project's objectives and scope.
items: Professional websites
Institutional websites, landing pages and custom web solutions to present your business and make it easier to get in touch.
A clear, responsive digital presence aligned with your identity.
Business websites and landing pages.
Custom systems
Web systems for specific needs, with features defined around your company's processes.
Organized information and support for your business's day-to-day tasks.
Features defined for each project.
Applications
Applications and digital solutions tailored to each project, considering the audience, features and context of use.
An experience planned around the problem you want to solve.
Development tailored to the project.
Website maintenance
Content updates, fixes, navigation improvements and optimization to keep your website useful and up to date.
Ongoing care for your digital presence.
Improvements and updates as needed.
Google Ads management
Campaign planning, setup, monitoring and optimization based on your business's agreed objectives.
Campaigns aligned with your services and the audience you want to reach.
Advertising spend is separate from the management fee.
process: You share your idea, audience and business needs.
We define deliverables, priorities and a suitable project quote.
We organize the stages and reviews agreed in the proposal.
services.pricing: There are no fixed prices: fees depend on each client's needs. Campaign results are not guaranteed.
